$Comment: A costume: for three minutes the wearer takes the Jack Skeleton's look (the model Hallows_Eve_Jack_Skeleton). It changes the model and is no debuff, which is what makes it a costume: the wearer can take it off any time with /zigcostume off, and no second costume goes over it. The Costume Wand's primary use and the trick-or-treat tricks put it on. Duration is in seconds.
